title: Prospective pride semantics versus lexical writing at one native channel
control_rule: Three fixed-seed same-layer random channels, own calibration quantiles; residual displacement explicitly recorded, not norm-matched.
capture: All132 cases; raw per-token pre/post at target+3controls, identical label-free carrier within each language. Natural corpus contains no question or choices.
calibration: Only60 cases from four predetermined calibration families; pooled signed per-token carrier q05/q10/q25/q50/q75/q90/q95. Separately calibrate semantic and lexical final prediction positions on calibration cases. Save/push numeric calibration before causal run.
causal_cases: All72 validation cases (60core +12lexical diagnostics); no calibration cases scored causally. All semanticcases in bothA/B orders; Englishcases additionally lexicalproud/pleased scoring.
semantic_endpoint: Conditional P(own-accomplishment interpretation) versus alternative, with pride/proud equivalents absent from options; exact A/B next-token odds, both orders averaged BEFORE aggregation. Correct-answer accuracy separately.
lexical_endpoint: English teacher-forced assistant prefix The person feels; exact single-token logodds for proud versus pleased, with leading spaces. Tokenization asserted before inference. Word choice is separate from semantic judgment.
scope: Carrier operations only on fixed label-free suffix inside user narrative; no direct intervention on later task/choice tokens or generated answers. Output operations only last prompt position predicting answer1. No repeated generation steering.
suppression: Only naturally high target events above calibrationcarrierq90 replaced with q50; this layer preactivations must be unchanged by its own same-forward interventions. Zero-ablation separate, not negative semantic pole.
association_gate: Positive pride-minus-neutral carriermean on>=75%of12heldoutfamily-languagepairs; separately report bylanguage and contrasts to joy/confidence/arrogance. Translations are related, not36independenttopics.
semantic_gate: Carrierq90 raises nonlexical prideprobability and high-event suppression lowers it on>=75%of12heldout own-accomplishmentfamily-languagepairs; paired mean changes exceed all three random-control directional changes. Require nonzero eligible high events for suppression; otherwise underpowered. Also report all72cases, accuracy and contextual inappropriate bias. Descriptive gate, not significance.
lexical_interpretation: Changes in proud/pleased without semantic gate support lexical-dominant effect in these tests; neither weak intervention nor null ablation proves absence of semantic contribution. Do not retrofit label after failures.
limits: Synthetic matched templates, only4heldoutfamilies and related translations, no native-speaker review.
Carrier clamp sustained at one quantile is bounded in scalar magnitude but need not match natural temporal dynamics.
Control displacements and downcolumn norms are reported, not exactly matched.
A/B judgments can be saturated or influenced by wording; report baseline and bothorders.
Only one coordinate tested; no global cleanliness/monosemanticity/subjectivefeelings claims.
No prompts, thresholds, candidate or operations retuned after outputs.
